instruction: Launch streaming playback of this video URL: https://devstreaming-cdn.apple.com/videos/streaming/examples/img_bipbop_adv_example_fmp4/master.m3u8
source: https://developer.apple.com/streaming/examples/ - Apple HLS test streams for developers

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task variation using the exact same Apple HLS test stream as the original task. This is a paraphrase variation with different wording. Uses the same evaluator logic (is_vlc_playing) which checks VLC status XML for the URL. The evaluator verifies that VLC is in 'playing' state and the URL matches the expected stream URL.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both VLC playing state and URL match
Getter (get_vlc_playing_info) properly extracts VLC status XML via HTTP interface
Metric (is_vlc_playing) correctly parses XML and validates state=='playing' and URL match
Complete instruction coverage: checks both 'launch streaming playback' (playing state) and 'this video URL' (URL verification)
Expected URL value is semantically correct and matches instruction exactly
Sophisticated URL matching logic with multiple fallback methods appropriate for HLS streams
Special handling for HLS streams where VLC may show just filename instead of full URL (lines 105-114 in vlc.py)
Multiple XML path searches ensure robustness (lines 75-84 in vlc.py)
State is accessible at runtime via VLC's HTTP interface, no postconfig needed
Data flow is correct: getter extracts status.xml → metric parses and verifies state + URL
